content: .{@-णीः@} .²1 the leader or chief of a village or community; तयोर्युद्धं समभवद्रक्षोग्रामणिमुख्ययोः <ls>Mb. 7. 109. 3</ls>. .²2 a leader or chief in general. .²3 a barber. .²4 an epithet of Viṣṇu. .²5 a libidinous man. .²6 a yakṣa; उन्नह्यन्ति रथं नागा ग्रामण्यो रथयोजकाः <ls>Mb. 12. 11. 48</ls>. --({%f.%}) .²1 a whore, harlot. .²2 the indigo plant.
